title: Implement soft-delete for records API
description: The records API currently hard-deletes rows on DELETE requests. Add soft-delete semantics: a deletedAt timestamp is set instead of removing the row, deleted records are excluded from normal list/get responses, and a new admin-only endpoint can list and restore soft-deleted records.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE requests set deletedAt instead of removing the row from storage.
Standard list and get endpoints exclude records with a non-null deletedAt by default.
The new admin list-deleted endpoint returns only soft-deleted records.
A restore endpoint clears deletedAt and makes the record visible again through standard endpoints.
Existing tests that assume hard-delete are updated to assert soft-delete semantics instead.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run the API integration tests covering delete, list-exclusion, admin listing, and restore flows.
groundTruth: Delete handler performs an update setting deletedAt = now() rather than a row removal; all read queries add a deletedAt IS NULL (or equivalent) predicate unless explicitly querying the admin deleted-records path.
